name: Hand-checked events from ECF 116, 185 and 282
description: 12 events extract_events listed on pages of the court's opinions of October 2022 and February 2023 and its December 2024 order rejecting the plea agreement. Each date, speaker and topic was read off the page by hand against classify_event's rules, so a disagreement here is a finding about the model. page_span is left empty: an eval run binds no filing, and classify_event reads the page as page_text.

columns.name: source_id
columns.description: The stored file this row is.

columns.name: source_sha256
columns.description: What the stored file's bytes hash to.

columns.name: ecf_entry
columns.description: The docket entry number the court gave the filing.

columns.name: attachment
columns.description: The attachment number within the entry; null for the main document.

columns.name: date_filed
columns.description: The day the court's docket records the entry as filed.

columns.name: description
columns.description: The docket's own description of the entry.

columns.name: page
columns.description: The page of the file, counting from 1.

columns.name: page_text
columns.description: The page's text as the PDF's text layer holds it.

columns.name: page_span
columns.description: The whole page, as a span a later step narrows to a quote. read_pages always fills it.

columns.name: statement
columns.description: One sentence saying what happened or who asserted what.

columns.name: quote_draft
columns.description: The words extract_events copied from the page for this event.

columns.name: date
columns.description: The day the event happened, read off its page by hand before the run was scored.

columns.name: speaker
columns.description: Whose act or assertion the event is, read off its page by hand.

columns.name: topic
columns.description: The topic the event is most about, of the eleven classify_event names, chosen by hand.
